profile.roads: Canterbury is a separate inland destination from the Thanet/Wantsum arrival context. Rome is a dispatch prologue, absent from this local map. No measured mission route or exact crossing is proposed.
profile.anachronisms: No present-day reclaimed Wantsum plain used as certain 597 dry ground, modern seawalls, airport, motor roads, later cathedral fabric or developed abbey precinct. The Roman AD43 bridgehead is a different event.
